cards.answer: Pantheon is a fighter and assassin focused on physical damage and AD. He leaps onto a target to stun them, uses empowered abilities, and blocks frontal damage with his shield.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from his leap and save damage for when his shield ends or you can attack from another direction.

cards.answer: Mortal Will builds stacks through basic attack hits and ability casts. At full stacks, his next basic ability consumes them for an additional effect.
cards.counterplay: Respect his empowered engage and avoid committing while his empowerment is ready.

cards.answer: Comet Spear is a quick thrust or a charged, longer-range throw that deals physical damage, increased against low-health enemies. The throw deals reduced damage beyond the first enemy hit; the thrust refunds part of its cooldown. Mortal Will adds physical damage.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the spear, retreat cautiously at low health, and use intervening enemies to soften the throw.

cards.answer: Shield Vault is a targeted leap that deals physical damage and briefly stuns. With Mortal Will, his next basic attack strikes repeatedly, with each hit applying on-hit effects and building Mortal Will stacks.
cards.counterplay: Keep outside his leap range and be cautious about the follow-up attack after an empowered leap.

cards.answer: Aegis Assault blocks non-turret damage from enemies in the direction his shield faces while dealing physical damage in front, ending with a damaging shield slam. Crowd control cannot interrupt the channel. With Mortal Will, he gains movement speed, armor and magic resistance after the slam.
cards.counterplay: Reposition away from his shield's facing or delay your damage; avoid spending crowd control just to stop the channel.

cards.answer: Grand Starfall passively grants armor penetration. Pantheon channels before leaping to a chosen location, where a spear deals physical damage and slows before his landing shockwave deals magic damage. Landing fills Mortal Will. His initial channel can be interrupted, but he becomes immune to crowd control after leaping.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the landing area and prepare for an empowered follow-up; interrupt his initial channel when possible.
